hooks.command: changed=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM HEAD 2>/dev/null); for f in $changed; do case "$f" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write --log-level silent "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; exit 0

if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"test"' package.json; then npx vitest run --silent 2>/dev/null || npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -20; elif [ -f pytest.ini ] || [ -f pyproject.toml ] || ls tests/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m pytest -q --tb=line 2>&1 | tail -15; fi; exit 0
